Lesson 4

Components

Build one piece of the screen, then reuse it.
beats.say: In this lesson we learn components. A component is one reusable part of the screen, written as a function.

beats.cap: Our app from the last lesson
beats.say: Here is our app from the last lesson. On the left is the code, on the right is the page in the browser.
Inside the src folder, make a new file. Call it Welcome dot J S X. Component names start with a capital letter.
Now we write a function called Welcome. It returns some J S X: a heading that says, Welcome to class. Then we export it so other files can use it.
Open App dot J S X. At the top, import Welcome. Then use it like a tag, under the heading. Save, and look at the browser.

beats.cap: Use it again: same component, many times
beats.say: The best part: we can use it again and again. Two more Welcome tags, and the page shows three greetings.
Now a common mistake. If I write welcome with a small letter, React thinks it is a plain HTML tag, and the console warns us.
Put the capital letter back, save, and the warning is gone. Always start component names with a capital letter.
